chunks: Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ali ibn Asbat from Khalaf ibn Hammad from Musa ibbad from Musa ibn Bakr from Muhammad ibn Marwan from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him): In
a husband who died and left a wife, he said: 'She has one-quarter, and the remainder is paid to the Imam.'

key_terms.الرُّبُعُ: one-quarter (the specific share for a childless wife)
key_terms.الْإِمَامُ: the Imam (the authoritative figure who receives the remainder)

ai.seo_question: What is the wife's share of inheritance if her husband dies childless according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the distribution of the residual estate (al-fard) when a wife is the sole heir, specifying that she receives one-quarter while the remainder reverts to the Imam. This ruling highlights the distinct Shia jurisprudential view that the Imam acts as the primary heir in the absence of other relatives, ensuring the estate remains within the divine authority rather than being distributed among distant kin or the state treasury.
